title: Swedish government offices to ban ChatGPT and Claude
script:
Sweden just banned ChatGPT and Claude from government offices.
The Government Offices of Sweden implemented this rule to secure sensitive internal information.
The Swedish Tax Agency already enforced a similar ban on these generative tools.
Employees must now use internal, approved software for all professional tasks.
The National Government Service Centre also joined these specific usage restrictions.
Would you trust a public official to handle your data without AI oversight?
